name: How long does a typical restoration remodeling project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical restoration remodeling project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a restoration remodeling project varies significantly based on the extent of damage, the size of the area, and the complexity of the desired changes. A small water damage restoration might take a few weeks, while extensive fire or seismic damage involving structural repairs and multiple rooms could extend to several months. We provide a detailed timeline after a thorough assessment of your property and project scope. Unexpected issues discovered during the process can also affect timelines.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project length varies greatly based on damage extent and project scope, from weeks for minor issues to several months for extensive structural repairs.
